installation.script:
#!/bin/bash

set -u

# [SETUP] Install necessary packages, including git
echo -e "[SETUP] Install packages"
apt-get update -qq > /dev/null 2>&1
apt-get install -qq > /dev/null 2>&1 -y git wget perl perl-doc fcgiwrap pkg-php-tools


#redis
apt-get install -qq -y php-redis

# Change to server directory
cd /mnt/server

# [SETUP] Create necessary folders
echo -e "[SETUP] Create folders"
mkdir -p logs

# Clone only the required directory from the repository
echo "[Git] Cloning webserver/files from application-eggs repository."
git clone --filter=blob:none --sparse https://github.com/pterodactyl/application-eggs.git /mnt/server/gtemp > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo "[Git] Repository cloned successfully." || { echo "[Git] Error: Repository clone failed."; exit 21; }

cd /mnt/server/gtemp

echo "[Git] Checking out webserver/files directory."
git sparse-checkout set webserver/files > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[Git] Error: Sparse checkout failed."; exit 22; }

# Copy the contents of webserver/files into /home/container
echo "[Git] Copying webserver/files contents to /home/container."
cp -r /mnt/server/gtemp/webserver/files/* /mnt/server || { echo "[Git] Error: Copying files failed."; exit 23; }

echo "[Git] Files copied successfully."

chmod +x /mnt/server/start.sh
chmod +x /mnt/server/core/nginx.sh
chmod +x /mnt/server/core/composer.sh

# Remove the temporary cloned repository
rm -rf /mnt/server/gtemp

#create temporary directory
mkdir -p /mnt/server/core/tmp

# Check if WordPress should be installed
if [ "${WORDPRESS}" == "true" ] || [ "${WORDPRESS}" == "1" ]; then
    echo "[SETUP] Install WordPress"
    cd /mnt/server/www
    wget -q http://wordpress.org/latest.tar.gz > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[SETUP] Error: Downloading WordPress failed."; exit 16; }
    tar xzf latest.tar.gz > /dev/null 2>&1
    mv wordpress/* .
    rm -rf wordpress latest.tar.gz
    echo "[SETUP] WordPress installed - http://ip:port/wp-admin"
fi


echo -e "[DONE] Everything has been installed successfully"
echo -e "[INFO] You can now start the nginx web server"

Enable or disable Wordpress 

0 = false (default) 
1 = true
